correctness.rationale: Direct full field-uniform proof: Peirce idempotent normalization removes a unique nonloop inner map. For nonloop arrows, square-polarization permits forward plus reverse arrow targets, while Leibniz permits only forward. For loops, odd characteristic forces same-vertex loop images, while characteristic two permits any loop target plus diagonal maps constant on each component of the undirected nonloop graph. The Leibniz subspace of the latter comprises local loop endomorphisms and exactly one loop-to-idempotent direction at each isolated vertex with a unique loop. Subtracting these explicit vector-space dimensions proves the formula and rigidity boundary. Actual separate coefficient constraint calculation agrees over F2,F3,F5 in 16 examples; finite cases do not prove infinite parameter theorem.
